text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh no, you're covered in mud, kitty! Sit still so I can wipe all that off you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Whoa! How'd you reach the very top of the playground equipment so fast?! You'll catch a cold up there…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hang in there, kitty! I'm coming, so there's nothing to be scared abo—ack!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: An obstacle course of swings, slides, and the like keeps Mejiro Palmer from reaching the cat and exhausts her instead…
